# `Q-5-47` — book-scope chapter Needs a File

> `book-scope: chapter` was requested for a whole-book render of a book.

## What this means

A request for `book-scope: chapter` (for example `-M book-scope:chapter`) was made while rendering a whole book with no file named. There is no chapter to choose.

## How to fix

Name the chapter to render (`q2 render ch1.qmd -M book-scope:chapter`), or drop the option to render the whole book.
